scenes.headline: How a speech model learns to sample in one step
scenes.sub: Pocket TTS trains its sampler head with drifting.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Quokka! This tiny speech model makes each frame of audio in one pass. Here is how drifting trains it.

scenes.text: Move the iteration into training: every step, pull each generated sample toward the data and push it away from its siblings.
scenes.mark: pull each generated sample toward the data
scenes.say: Diffusion refines a sample step by step at generation time. Drifting moves that refinement into training.

steps.say: A causal transformer reads the text, the voice and the audio so far.
A small head turns that context plus fresh noise into one plausible frame.
One pass gives the next latent, which feeds back in.

scenes.title: Two ways to get one step

left.title: LSD, the old head
items: Learns a flow, then jumps it
left.say: The old head jumped along a learned flow, which needs an extra derivative in training.

right.title: Drifting, the new head
items: The generator is the one step
Squared error to a frozen target
right.say: Drifting needs only a squared error to a frozen target.

steps.say: Data pulls a sample one way, its siblings push it the other, and it moves along the difference.
When the two crowds match, the pulls cancel and the field is zero.

parts.note: the sample, nudged one drift step
parts.say: Nudge the sample one drift step.

parts.note: a frozen target: no Jacobian anywhere
parts.say: Freeze that as the target. Descent then moves the sample along the field.

scenes.title: The kernel temperature
scenes.say: The kernel's temperature sets how far a sample can feel.

items.say: Too tight, and a sample far from the data feels only its siblings. It never moves.

items.text: Too wide: sees only the mean
items.say: Too wide, and the samples slide over as one lump.
So it is learned: wide at first, tighter as the samples close in.

scenes.title: UTMOS at 250k steps
scenes.say: Fixed at the value learning ends at, the model stays unintelligible. The annealing matters.

scenes.label: word error rate with drifting, against 0.91% for LSD
scenes.note: same inference cost, about twice the training time
scenes.say: It matches the old head at the same inference cost, for about twice the training time.

scenes.text: One step at inference comes from iterating during training, and the kernel temperature has to anneal with the samples.
scenes.say: One step at inference comes from iterating in training.

recap: A one-pass head, trained by drifting
Pull to data, push from siblings
Learn the temperature, never fix it
scenes.say: To recap: one pass, trained by drifting. Pull toward data, push from siblings. And learn the temperature.
